# cddml-Ju8PqWxZrKt
# File Name: advanced_social_media_text_analytics_with_pandas.py

import numpy as np  # type: ignore
import pandas as pd  # type: ignore
import datetime  # type: ignore
from datetime import datetime as dt, timedelta  # type: ignore
import re  # type: ignore
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt  # type: ignore
import seaborn as sns  # type: ignore
from sklearn.datasets import fetch_20newsgroups  # type: ignore
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer  # type: ignore
from sklearn.decomposition import LatentDirichletAllocation  # type: ignore
from nltk.sentiment.vader import SentimentIntensityAnalyzer  # type: ignore
import nltk  # type: ignore

nltk.download("vader_lexicon")
from wordcloud import WordCloud  # type: ignore
import optuna  # type: ignore
from joblib import dump, load  # type: ignore
from typing import List, Tuple, Dict, Any

# Metadata and configuration variables
project_timestamp: str = dt.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
estimated_timeframe: str = "4-6 months"
problem_domain: str = "Social Media Text Analytics, Topic Modeling, and Sentiment Analysis"
use_cases: List[str] = [
    "Social media trend analysis",
    "Brand sentiment monitoring",
    "Customer feedback analysis",
    "Topic discovery in news articles"
]
frameworks: List[str] = ["Pandas", "NumPy", "Scikit-Learn", "NLTK", "Gensim", "Matplotlib", "Seaborn", "Optuna",
                         "WordCloud"]
development_lifecycle: List[str] = [
    "Requirement Analysis", "Data Acquisition", "Data Preprocessing", "Exploratory Data Analysis",
    "Model Development", "Evaluation", "Deployment", "Monitoring", "Maintenance"
]
sister_projects: List[str] = [
    "Advanced Recommender Systems", "Financial Time Series Forecasting", "Predictive Maintenance"
]
integrated_applications: List[str] = [
    "CRM Systems", "Business Intelligence Dashboards", "Marketing Automation Platforms"
]
key_learnings: Dict[str, List[str]] = {
    "Features": ["Text Preprocessing", "TF-IDF Vectorization", "Topic Modeling", "Sentiment Analysis", "Visualization"],
    "Components": ["Pandas", "Scikit-Learn", "NLTK", "LatentDirichletAllocation", "TfidfVectorizer", "WordCloud"],
    "Keywords": ["Social Media Analytics", "Topic Modeling", "Sentiment Analysis", "Text Mining", "Data Fusion"],
    "Research Areas": ["Natural Language Processing", "Text Analytics", "Machine Learning", "Data Visualization"],
    "Hashtags": ["#TextAnalytics", "#TopicModeling", "#SentimentAnalysis", "#DataScience", "#Pandas"]
}


# Data loading and preprocessing
def load_newsgroups_data() -> pd.DataFrame:
    data: Any = fetch_20newsgroups(subset="all", remove=("headers", "footers", "quotes"))
    df: pd.DataFrame = pd.DataFrame({"text": data.data})
    return df


def preprocess_text(text: str) -> str:
    text: str = text.lower()
    text: str = re.sub(r"[^a-z\s]", "", text)
    text: str = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()
    return text


def preprocess_dataset(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df["clean_text"] = df["text"].apply(preprocess_text)
    return df


# Feature extraction: TF-IDF vectorization
def vectorize_text(df: pd.DataFrame, max_features: int = 1000) -> Tuple[np.ndarray, List[str]]:
    vectorizer: TfidfVectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(max_features=max_features, stop_words="english")
    X_tfidf: np.ndarray = vectorizer.fit_transform(df["clean_text"]).toarray()
    feature_names: List[str] = vectorizer.get_feature_names_out().tolist()
    return X_tfidf, feature_names


# Topic Modeling using LDA
def run_topic_modeling(X_tfidf: np.ndarray, n_topics: int = 10) -> Tuple[np.ndarray, LatentDirichletAllocation]:
    lda: LatentDirichletAllocation = LatentDirichletAllocation(n_components=n_topics, random_state=42)
    lda_topics: np.ndarray = lda.fit_transform(X_tfidf)
    return lda_topics, lda


def display_topics(model: LatentDirichletAllocation, feature_names: List[str], n_top_words: int = 10) -> None:
    for topic_idx, topic in enumerate(model.components_):
        message: str = "Topic #%d: " % topic_idx
        message += " ".join([feature_names[i] for i in topic.argsort()[:-n_top_words - 1:-1]])
        print(message)


# Sentiment Analysis using VADER
def analyze_sentiment(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    sid: SentimentIntensityAnalyzer = SentimentIntensityAnalyzer()
    df["sentiment"] = df["clean_text"].apply(lambda x: sid.polarity_scores(x)["compound"])
    return df


# Visualization: Word Cloud
def generate_wordcloud(text: str) -> None:
    wordcloud: WordCloud = WordCloud(width=800, height=400, background_color="white").generate(text)
    plt.figure(figsize=(10, 5))
    plt.imshow(wordcloud, interpolation="bilinear")
    plt.axis("off")
    plt.show()


# Hyperparameter Tuning for LDA using Optuna
def optuna_lda_objective(trial: optuna.trial.Trial, X_tfidf: np.ndarray) -> float:
    n_topics: int = trial.suggest_int("n_topics", 5, 15)
    lda: LatentDirichletAllocation = LatentDirichletAllocation(n_components=n_topics, random_state=42)
    lda.fit(X_tfidf)
    score: float = lda.score(X_tfidf)
    return score


def run_lda_optuna(X_tfidf: np.ndarray) -> optuna.study.Study:
    study: optuna.study.Study = optuna.create_study(direction="maximize")
    study.optimize(lambda trial: optuna_lda_objective(trial, X_tfidf), n_trials=20)
    return study


# Example input and expected output simulation
def simulate_example_input() -> pd.DataFrame:
    sample_data: pd.DataFrame = pd.DataFrame({
        "text": [
            "I absolutely love the new design of your product, it is fantastic and innovative!",
            "The service was terrible and the experience was disappointing.",
            "Average experience; nothing special, could be improved.",
            "I am extremely happy with the customer support and the quality of the product."
        ]
    })
    return sample_data


def expected_output_example(df: pd.DataFrame) -> None:
    df_preprocessed: pd.DataFrame = preprocess_dataset(df)
    X_tfidf_sample, features_sample = vectorize_text(df_preprocessed, max_features=50)
    lda_topics_sample, lda_model_sample = run_topic_modeling(X_tfidf_sample, n_topics=2)
    display_topics(lda_model_sample, features_sample, n_top_words=5)
    df_sentiment: pd.DataFrame = analyze_sentiment(df_preprocessed)
    print("Sentiment Scores:\n", df_sentiment[["text", "sentiment"]])
    combined_text: str = " ".join(df_preprocessed["clean_text"].tolist())
    generate_wordcloud(combined_text)


# Main Pipeline Execution
if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Timestamp and metadata
    current_timestamp: str = dt.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
    print("Current Timestamp:", current_timestamp)

    # Load dataset from 20 Newsgroups as a proxy for social media data
    df_newsgroups: pd.DataFrame = load_newsgroups_data()
    df_preprocessed: pd.DataFrame = preprocess_dataset(df_newsgroups)

    # Vectorize text and run topic modeling
    X_tfidf, tfidf_features = vectorize_text(df_preprocessed, max_features=1000)
    lda_topics, lda_model = run_topic_modeling(X_tfidf, n_topics=10)
    display_topics(lda_model, tfidf_features, n_top_words=10)

    # Run sentiment analysis
    df_sentiment: pd.DataFrame = analyze_sentiment(df_preprocessed)
    print("Average Sentiment Score:", df_sentiment["sentiment"].mean())

    # Generate word cloud for overall text
    all_text: str = " ".join(df_preprocessed["clean_text"].tolist())
    generate_wordcloud(all_text)

    # Hyperparameter tuning for LDA using Optuna
    lda_study: optuna.study.Study = run_lda_optuna(X_tfidf)
    print("Optuna Best Params for LDA:", lda_study.best_params)

    # Example input simulation for demonstration
    example_df: pd.DataFrame = simulate_example_input()
    expected_output_example(example_df)

    # Key Learnings / Research Areas (printed as a dictionary)
    key_learnings: Dict[str, List[str]] = {

                     "WordCloud Visualization"],
        "Components": ["Pandas", "Scikit-Learn", "NLTK", "LatentDirichletAllocation", "TfidfVectorizer", "Optuna",
                       "WordCloud"],
        "Keywords": ["Social Media Analytics", "Topic Modeling", "Sentiment Analysis", "Text Mining", "Data Fusion"],
        "Research Areas": ["Natural Language Processing", "Text Analytics", "Machine Learning", "Data Visualization"],
        "Hashtags": ["#TextAnalytics", "#TopicModeling", "#SentimentAnalysis", "#DataScience", "#Pandas"]
    }
    print("Key Learnings:\n", key_learnings)

    # Project metadata and final product details
    project_timestamp: str = dt.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
    print("Project Timestamp:", project_timestamp)
    estimated_timeframe: str = "3-4 months for initial prototype, 6-9 months for full deployment"
    print("Estimated Completion Timeframe:", estimated_timeframe)
